name: lost-in-the-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin suite for the lost-in-the tools: grove (git worktree manager for tmux or herdr) and woods (Rails code-intelligence gem). Each plugin is a git-subdir reference into its home repo, so installs fetch only the skill subtree — not the whole codebase.

plugins.name: grove-plugin
plugins.description: Grove worktree management skill: zero-friction git worktree workflows with tmux or herdr sessions, for AI agents and humans. Requires grove >= 0.8.0; herdr support needs grove >= 0.11.0, and the skill checks the installed version before using it.

plugins.name: woods-plugin
plugins.description: Woods guides for agents: setup and upgrade, MCP configuration, codebase investigation, repository agent enablement, and diagnosis, plus optional edit-refresh and context hooks. Base guide workflows support woods 2.0.0.beta1 or newer; each skill checks installed capabilities before using newer helpers. The plugin version is independent of the gem version.
